answer_en: Section 46(1) of the Electoral Act, 2026, stipulates that the Presiding Officer must open the ballot box or present the voting device at the hour specified for opening the poll, before accreditation and voting commence. They must show the ballot box to the people lawfully present, then close and seal it so that no one can open it without permission [act-s46-0]. The ballot box remains open and visible to all people until the poll closes.
